$comment: The common delivery path from the course operating model, plus the failure states that make it honest. Groups extend states, transitions, and evidence requirements for their track; they should not remove the failure states.

intake.description: A work item exists and its request is recorded.

context.description: The context required to act has been assembled and its provenance recorded.

route.description: An autonomy level and path have been selected, with the inputs to that decision recorded.

act.description: The change was attempted in isolation.

verify.description: Deterministic checks ran and their results are recorded, pass or fail.

approve.description: A named human or gate accepted the result against stated acceptance conditions.

handoff.description: The artifact was published or handed to its consumer with its contract.

observe.description: The outcome was measured after handoff. Not terminal: an observed artifact is retired, or its observation opens a new item.

blocked.description: Work cannot proceed without an input that the system cannot obtain on its own.

escalated.description: A human owner has been asked to decide. Autonomous work has stopped.

rejected.description: The item was declined at a gate and will not proceed in this form.

retired.description: A previously handed-off artifact has been withdrawn from use.

limits.$comment: Budgets the harness enforces. verify -> act is the correction loop; when it is exhausted the item escalates rather than retrying.
